characters._about: Named characters placed in Reece with /questnpc place <id>, or brought by encounters. Each: name, entity (default minecraft:villager), profession (villagers), idle (lines when they have nothing for you).

maren.name: Elder Maren
idle: Reece is small, but it's never quiet for long.
Read the Field Guide when you're unsure. I wrote half of it.

wren.name: Sister Wren
idle: The forest still hasn't answered me.
Light a candle at the shrine if you pass it.

edda.name: Old Edda
idle: Everyone comes back to the graveyard eventually. Some come back sooner.
Mind how you go.

hale.name: Captain Hale
idle: Watch the tree line at dusk.
Keep your shield up and your back to a wall.

dagna.name: Guildmaster Dagna Holt
idle: A good pick and a better lantern. That's all a miner needs.
Mind the gravel.

marta.name: Marta Furrow
idle: Rain's coming. The barley knows it before I do.
There's always work in the fields.

halloway.name: Commodore Marlow Halloway
idle: The society meets on the jetty. Bring a rod.
Tide's turning. Good time to fish.

bess.name: Bess Copperpot
idle: Stew's on. Pull up a stool.
Nobody leaves my tavern hungry.

rue.name: Mother Rue
idle: Every weed is a medicine to someone.
Pick only what you need.

bram.name: Bram the Baker
idle: Smell that? No, nor do I. No flour, no bread.
Mind the oven, it bites.

hesk.name: Miller Hesk
idle: The mill turns when the wind does.
Grain in, flour out. Usually.

nell.name: Nell the Weaver
idle: Straw, canvas, wool. Everything starts as something plainer.
Don't touch the loom.

olsen.name: Olsen the Carpenter
idle: Measure twice. Then measure again, because you got it wrong.
Only the old birch will do.

silas.name: Silas Pike
idle: Back again? I'll still out-fish you.
